events.name: Homo Hotel Happy Hour
events.description:
Tulsa's queerest happy hour is a First Friday tradition. The Homo Hotel opens its doors for an evening of community, conversation, and cocktails. Whether you're new to Tulsa or a longtime local, this is THE place to kick off your weekend with your LGBTQ+ family. All are welcome - bring a friend, make a friend, be yourself. No cover, just vibes.

This Friday, September 04 - don't miss it!
